nl: Add After=network.target to the [Unit] section of etc/systemd/system/reports.service, after the Description line.
reference_bash:
python3 - <<'EOF'
import pathlib
p = pathlib.Path('etc/systemd/system/reports.service'); t = p.read_text()
assert t.count('Description=Report generator\n') == 1
p.write_text(t.replace('Description=Report generator\n', 'Description=Report generator\nAfter=network.target\n'))
EOF
